name: 家用双头温和脱毛仪款
description: 蛋形手持双头脱毛仪，白绿清新系套图，卖点场景对比参数全覆盖

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft mint #DCE8DE and sage #BFD0C0 panels for info shots, deep pine green #4F7D62 for feature annotation, warm ivory #F5F3EE for lifestyle and spec screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, cool neutral white balance, no harsh speculars on the glossy shell
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte ribbed podium, smooth ivory stone counter and clean matte infographic boards
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold short headlines with a small pill badge above
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line single-color icons in deep pine green #4F7D62, rounded square and circular card containers
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the egg-shaped handheld body across the set, device always upright with light window visible
noDrift: no invented efficacy claims or numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh clean personal-care appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ivory white #F5F3EE, soft mint green #DCE8DE, deep pine green #4F7D62 and charcoal text #33383D; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key, soft contact shadows and cool neutral white balance; modern geometric sans-serif with bold short headlines and a small pill badge; consistent thin-line single-color icon style in rounded cards; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, device standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The handheld egg-shaped device standing upright, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible with its head window facing the camera. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. No extra whitespace beyond even margins. 8K commercial appliance e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no glowing light beams, no invented indicator readings, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 双机位陈列图与 IPL 卖点标语；P2-P3 四宫格图标卡（360°、出光面积等）；P3-P4 三圆形传统脱毛方式对比与标语；P4-P5 模特屏与「一脱双头」标语；P6-P7 感应头适用部位卡与三卡机制说明；P8 使用前后 VS 空白看板；P9 正面注释图（空白标注圈）；P10 产品参数表（品名嫩肤脱毛仪、颜色象牙白/魅力蓝、光源优化脉冲光、档位、闪次、防水等级）及会员促销角标。品类判定：源夹名为「洗护」，但 P10 参数区品名明确为「嫩肤脱毛仪」，产品为带滚轮机头与出光窗、需供电的手持个护电器，故改判 L1=家用电器、L2=个护电器（taxonomy 逐字命中），非护肤个护。已剥离：原品牌字与装饰英文字样、模特面容（P5 正脸改为无面部出镜）、会员/促销角标、全部原文案原句。功效重灾区处理：脱毛次数（40万次闪光）、永久/几周见效、95%消费者认同、毛囊萎缩机制、无感脱毛、能量档位 5 档、IPX7 防水、出光面积数值等一律不作为事实写入，仅以 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位或空白 proof 位。源页自相矛盾：出光面积 P2 写 4.5cm² 而 P6 写 4cm²，闪次 P1 与 P10 表述不一致，两种数值均未写入。
